SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. C. I. D. 96
CENTRAL Div.
Date....................
Date March 12, 1929

Subject (in full) O. K. Mayer alias C.M. Maur alias Matias.

Made by D.I. Robertson. Forwarded by J.Klivens A.C. Pol

With reference to the attached letter of
March 6, 1928 from Mr. Thurston R. Porter, United States
Marshal for China, re O.M. Mayer alias C.M. Maur also known
as Mattias, an individual who goes under the name of A.
Camporelli, was located in a boarding house at 84 Bubbling
Well Road and recognized by the Boarding House Staff from
a photograph on file. This information was conveyed to the
U.S. Authorities on March 9, but owing to the absence of the
Deputy Marshal of the U.S. Court the matter was left over
until March 11. On the latter date our file photograph was
compared with one in possession of the Deputy Marshal of the
U.S. Court and both found to be identical.

It has been ascertained, however, that "Matias",
under which name he is known to us, appeared before the old
Mixed Court on 18.2.24 in connection with civil proceedings as
a citizen of the Argentine Republic, and under the same
nationality was sentenced to one month's imprisonment and
expulsion at the French Mixed Court on 10.3.24 for trafficking
in opium and embezzlement. In view of this Dr. Sellett had
telegraphed to the Philippine Authorities for further
information regarding the nationality of "Matias" and requests
we delay further action pending a reply being received.

Matias arrived in Shanghai from Manila on
1.2.29 and describes himself as an Italian; he was accompanied
by a woman of the cafe and bar type who calls herself Mrs.
R. Merkle.

A. Colustio
D. I.

A/D.C.I.

中央分区

日期：1929年3月12日

事由（全称） O. K. Mayer，化名 C.M. Maur，化名 Matias。

由侦探督察 Robertson 撰写。经助理警司 Klivens 转呈

关于随附的1928年3月6日美国驻华法警 Thurston R. Porter 先生的来信，涉及 O.M. Mayer，化名 C.M. Maur，亦称 Mattias，此人使用 A. Camporelli 之名，经查住在静安寺路84号的一家寄宿公寓内，并由该寄宿公寓职员根据存档照片辨认确认。此信息已于3月9日通报美方当局，但由于美国法院副法警缺席，此事暂缓至3月11日处理。在后者日期，我方存档照片与美国法院副法警所持照片进行了比对，发现两者完全一致。

然而，经查实，“Matias”（即我方所知之其名）曾于1924年2月18日以阿根廷共和国公民身份，因民事诉讼出庭于旧混合法庭；并同样以该国国籍，于1924年3月10日在法国混合法庭因贩卖鸦片和侵吞公款罪被判处一个月监禁并驱逐出境。鉴于此，Sellett 博士已致电菲律宾当局，查询有关“Matias”国籍的进一步信息，并要求我们在收到回复前暂缓采取进一步行动。

Matias 于1929年2月1日从马尼拉抵达上海，自称意大利人；随行有一名自称 R. Merkle 夫人的女子，职业为咖啡馆及酒吧女侍。

A. Colustio
侦探督察

助理刑事侦缉处长

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D....96....
Date......7.3.29....

UNITED STATES COURT FOR CHINA
SHANGHAI, CHINA

March 6, 1929.

Commissioner of Police,
Administration Building,
18 Hankow Road, Shanghai.

Sir:

This office is in receipt of a cablegram from the
Governor-General of the Philippine Islands, reading as
follows:

CAUSE ARREST OF O. M. MAYER, ALIAS C. M.
MAUR CHARGED PHILIPPINE COURTS WITH VIOLATION
ACT NUMBERED THIRTYTHREE THIRTEEN (FRAUDULENT
ISSUE OF CHECK). ACCUSED NOW LIVING IN FRENCH
CONCESSION WITH ONE SANTIAGO SPANISH SUBJECT.
PHOTOGRAPH MAILED FORMAL DEMAND AND PAPERS
FOLLOW.

(Signed) STIMSON

I understand that your department knows this man,
who sometimes goes under the name of Mattias.

Will you, therefore, lend every possible assistance
toward effecting his arrest?

Very respectfully yours,
Thurston R Porter
Thurston R. Porter,
United States Marshal for China.

（批：L.S. / File / Attach 7/3）
（批：9905 / 9/38 / 9/29）

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处登记室
编号：I. O. D....96....
日期......1929年3月7日....

美国驻中国法院
中国，上海

1929年3月6日。

警务处处长，
行政大楼，
上海汉口路18号。

先生：

本办事处收到菲律宾群岛总督发来的电报，内容如下：

逮捕 O. M. MAYER，化名 C. M.
MAUR，被菲律宾法院指控违反
第三十三号第十三条法案（欺诈性签发支票）。被告现与一名
圣地亚哥西班牙籍人士居住在法租界。
照片已邮寄，正式引渡请求及文件随后寄出。

（签名） STIMSON

我获悉贵部门认识此人，
他有时使用 Mattias 之名。

因此，能否请你们提供一切可能的协助，
以执行对其逮捕？

此致
敬礼
Thurston R Porter
Thurston R. Porter，
美国驻华法警。

（批：L.S. / 归档 / 附件 3月7日）
（批：9905 / 1938年9月 / 1929年9月）
